name: Ashkelon
overview: Ashkelon, also referred to as Askelon, was one of the five chief cities of the Philistines, as noted alongside Gaza, Ekron, Ashdod, and Gath. Scripture records its capture by the people of Judah, emphasizing its strategic importance. The city is notably connected to the story of Samson, who, empowered by the Spirit of the LORD, killed thirty men there. Prophetic passages in Jeremiah pronounce judgment upon Ashkelon, highlighting its destruction and the LORD’s charge against it, demonstrating God's sovereign control over the Philistine cities.
